For a finite original core with active labelled palette, fixed positive floors at most original root sizes and original hitting number 3..4, let M be its inclusion-maximal original label footprints. Keep ALL original protected hidden completions fixed.

Build vertices by assigning each existing label a member of M or the empty footprint, subject to original floors and an actual at-most-four-label cover. Two uniformly safe labelled cores are connected by safe single incidence toggles **if and only if** their maximal expansions lie in the same assignment component. # Tight upper-cover handover and exact persistent-cover obstruction

Date: 2026-10-10 UTC. Prospective analytical and verification freeze, before execution. Integrated parent9030d5c8637083f17c073962d71ce3c1616aab95. Status OPEN until the complete scientific closeout.

## Setting and question
Use the inherited finite core-only setting: original active palette P of size N, original positive floors, source hitting number in{3,4}, fixed original protected hidden completions, single incidence toggles. Universal safety is exactly original floors, actual core hitting number<=4 and every current footprint contained in an ORIGINAL footprint. Observation/access/addresses and committed progress remain supplied assumptions. No source-fiber reset or new primitive.

A persistent cover is ONE fixed subset H of actual label identities, |H|<=4, hitting every root at EVERY slice. A moving cover is an actual <=4 cover at each slice with identities allowed to change. A safe endpoint need not be reachable. A reachable reserve need not be reachable with a persistent cover. Distinguish ANY first vacancy from absence of a prescribed label after an earlier vacancy.

## Theorem1: marked count quotient for a prescribed persistent cover
Let M_0=empty,M_1,...,M_k be the original maximal footprints. Set h=min(4,N). Any persistent cover of size<=4 can be enlarged to size h from the existing palette. Enumerate every size-h source cover H, keeping its actual identities. For ANY-vacancy use distinguished labels D=H. For prescribed absence of r, use D=H union{r}. Order H first, with r last when it is additional, and put d=|D|<=5.

A vertex consists of the ordered d marked types (t_1,...,t_d) and nonnegative unmarked counts(n_0,...,n_k) summing to N-d. It must meet the original floors, and the union of the first h ACTUAL marked footprints must cover every root. The latter supplies the upper bound; it is not a count of possible donors. Every actual label is retained, including empty coordinates.

An edge changes one marked type, or transfers one unmarked label between two types. In either case evaluate the EXACT meet core: replace that one donor footprint by the intersection of its old and new maxima, leave all other actual footprints unchanged. Require original floors and actual coverage by the SAME H in this meet. Native lift deletes to the meet then adds within the destination; each slice contains the meet, so both floors and H coverage persist, and original domination holds.

This is exactly the orbit quotient of the labelled maximal-assignment graph restricted to persistent H. Projection follows from relabelling invariance of unmarked labels. Conversely every quotient edge lifts from EVERY labelled assignment in its source orbit: select the specified marked donor or any unmarked donor of the specified source type. Exact meet safety is invariant under permutation of unmarked labels. Every quotient path thus lifts from the actual source expansion, not merely from some representative.

The inherited expansion, expansion-choice and compression proofs also hold with H fixed: expansion preserves H coverage; the intersection of two expansions contains the original H-covered core; successive safe raw toggles admit compatible expansions. Therefore source-component membership in this quotient is necessary and sufficient for an H-persistent safe native path. Source expansion can use any original containing maximum, and retains empties.

ANY vacancy is the predicate some marked type0 OR n_0>0. Prescribed absence is the predicate that r's distinguished type is0. The latter must NOT be replaced by anonymous empty-count existence. At most (k+1)^d binomial(N-d+k,k) vertices occur. This is polynomial in N only when k is fixed; no general polynomial-time or native shortest-path claim.

## Corollary2: exact test for unavoidable cover movement
Unrestricted safe reserve existence is decided by the inherited count quotient. Its ANY-vacancy yes/no also decides prescribed absence via the safe absent-label rename interface. A safe ANY/prescribed reserve can be reached with a persistent cover iff at least one source H quotient reaches the corresponding vacancy predicate. Thus when unrestricted reachability holds but every eligible H fails, every safe path to that reserve must change its protecting <=4 label set. These are source-component tests, not static endpoint tests. They decide reserve predicates; they do not decide exact labelled-target connectivity.

## Theorem3: a fully saturated family with an unavoidable prescribed cover handover
Take the previously proved crossed-block source for r>=2:
A_i={b,u,c_i}, B_i={b,v,c_i}, R={u,v,c_0,...,c_(r-1),y}, T={e}.
Adjoin one actual root Z={z}, using one additional EXISTING source label z. All floors equal source sizes:3 private,r+3 atR,1 atT andZ. This is an explicit enlarged source family; no fresh label is introduced during execution.

The original maximum types are the old D,U,V,K_i,E plus {Z}. Source hitting number is exactly4: the old source needs3 and z is disjoint. Every originally dominated current core has hitting number at least4: any smaller current cover maps its footprints into original footprints and would give a smaller source cover. The original universal safety criterion caps it at4. All safe CORES therefore have hitting number EXACTLY4. Original protected FULL completions remain in{3,4}; hidden labels can lower a full completion to3, so exact4 is not asserted for them.

For r>=3 execute the inherited ordered-distinct-triple release L of b (4r+6 toggles), leaving Z and z unchanged. Its actual u,v,e cover becomes u,v,e,z. Then add b at T and delete e at T. These two toggles safely rename e into the already absent b; original E dominates both footprints, floors hold and the actual cover changes from {u,v,e,z} to {u,v,b,z}. Total achieved cost4r+8. At the endpoint e is absent, b occupiesT, every other old incidence agrees with L's endpoint and every root returns to its original saturated cardinality. e is NOT the first absent label: b becomes absent two edits earlier. No claim of native optimality or first-vacancy cover necessity.

Every source cover must contain e, because sourceT={e}. At an endpoint with e absent, a set of at most4 labels containing e has at most3 active members and cannot cover a tau4 core. Consequently NO fixed at-most-four label set covers both source and this endpoint. This proves unavoidable cover movement for ANY safe path reaching prescribed e absence, independently of the constructed path. At the intermediate slice T={e,b}, both four-covers are simultaneously actual; the union has five labels but is never asserted to be an allowed four-cover. There is no extra unit of hitting-number budget.

The original all-anchored-failure proof carries over: z cannot release without violating Z; other donors cannot enter Z while retaining their original footprint; all old anchored obstructions remain. Static minimum becomes r+5=N-1 for r>=3 and N=8 for r2. Disjoint Z needs>=1 active label, while the restriction to old roots needs the inherited minimum. r2 admits safe additions but no static vacancy.

From the achieved e vacancy, inherited exact permutation/restoration and finite renewal are available. This checkpoint claims the prescribed reserve handover and general persistent-cover criterion, not a new full-palette permutation campaign. The ANY first vacancy b still has persistent four-cover. General structural conditions forcing movement before ANY first vacancy remain OPEN.

These sources have tau3 or4. Universe B: every nondecreasing multiset of FIVE singleton footprints from{1,2,4} whose union is7; append sixth label with footprint8. These have tau4. The checker must reconstruct the entire universe, never trust producer case lists/counts/digests.

Retain complete source/H/target identities and canonical vertex/edge/component digests. Hashes encode complete identities, not sampled paths. Include nontrivial unmarked permutations in universe B.

Verify all anchored failures and static multiplicity minima by complete maximal-type multiplicity enumeration up to N. r2 safe-add/no-static-vacancy control.

# Universal core-region criterion and reserved-label bypass — closeout

Status: scoped theorem CLOSED. Exact repair on the saturated disjoint-role template is OBSTRUCTED with only active labels and CONSTRUCTIVE with one reserved unused core label. Broad C3/general C4 remain OPEN. No numbered v16 or full-stack/post-merge certification is claimed.

## Scientific discovery

For an original finite nonempty core C with hitting number 3 or 4, positive original floors at most core sizes, and ALL protected completions by a disjoint nonempty hidden palette, a candidate core D is universally admissible exactly when:

1. Its core supports satisfy the original floors.
2. Its core hitting number is at most 4.
3. Every current core-label footprint is contained in some original core-label footprint (empty footprints allowed).

This removes the hidden-completion quantifier from this safety decision. Necessity uses a single hidden label on the complement of a violating footprint; sufficiency replaces current core hits by original core hits and leaves hidden hits unchanged. The original C remains the reference throughout a path. Arbitrarily many hidden labels are covered by the proof, not by extrapolation from the finite census. The criterion decides admissibility, not general connectivity or native observer origin.

The saturated template has m roots with {A}, two singleton roles {B}, {C}, and host {D,E}. With only these five active labels it has NO uniformly safe first edit across its full source fiber: deletion violates a floor in the empty-hidden world; every valid addition mixes disjoint original footprints. With one reserved globally absent core label w, use +w at host, remove D there, add D at ALL m A-roots, remove A at ALL those roots, add A at host, and remove w. Every slice is universally safe and the endpoint exactly exchanges A,D while preserving hidden incidences.

The route uses 2m+4 committed toggles, the sharp uniform minimum: 2m+2 endpoint differences plus at least two off-endpoint toggles. Peak excess is max(1,m), not a single-excess claim. Current core and the supplied ordered template identify the next request and exact endpoint. Optional NOOPs can stall forever; no physical progress law is derived.

This does not make the previous fixed-family admission predicate true. The hidden common label can persist while the SAME intended exact repair destination is reached by another route. Buffer choreography was already known; the new result is the exact universal criterion and its full-completion operational application, including resource necessity and uniform optimality. Core access, static addresses, original protected-band knowledge and reserved-label availability remain explicit premises.

## Reproducible evidence

- [Prospective scope/proof freeze](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/commit/49227fd7c18fe4ec358817102e1e31ff43d8c965).
- [Initial test/absent-implementation RED](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/commit/c53835ab4127dabd460b5b47bde955a2be61f9b6).
